function.name: query_repair_standards
function.description: Searches the official RoadGuard knowledge base for municipal traffic regulations, road maintenance standards, hazard thresholds, and safety guidelines.

query.description: The specific question or search query to run against the knowledge base in English or Hebrew.

issuing_body.description: Optional. Filters the documents by the issuing organization. Supported values: 'Ariel Municipality', 'Jerusalem Municipality', 'Tel Aviv-Yafo Municipality', 'Netivei Israel', 'ASTM International', 'Ayalon Highways'.
